question: Add a record for Namecheap as a paid domain registrar, with first-year, renewal and transfer prices for .com, .net, .org, .io, .co, .ai, .dev, .app, .xyz and .online?
why: https://www.namecheap.com/domains/ (read 2026-11-03, capture sha256:6d61687d4a928be0ae327cf669dbeb17a0adf746e4052e6e594315567f99d362) lists register / renew / transfer in USD per year, first-year register price is a sale price where one is shown: .com 12.08 / 19.98 / 12.28; .net 12.48 / 18.58 / 12.98; .org 8.48 / 18.98 / 12.28; .io 29.98 / 75.98 / 65.98; .co 19.98 / 45.48 / 38.48; .ai 89.98 / 114.98 / 99.98 (minimum 2-year registration); .dev 10.98 / 20.98 / 15.98; .app 10.98 / 22.98 / 17.98; .xyz 2.00 / 21.48 / 17.58; .online 0.98 (1 per household) / 35.68 / 32.48. The ICANN fee of 0.20 per year is added to the listed price for some domains at purchase (capture sha256:f61817bacc7aef3e53d20507b750abac613cd7378992559dde61b9c032f030b0). Namecheap registrar prices describe a paid registrar offer, not the free DNS service the in-scope record covers, and docs/domains-dns/paid/tlds.md has no Namecheap row and the corpus has no Namecheap registrar record; a discover unit should add domains-dns/namecheap-registrar with these rows, each with its quote.
